title: MSFS 2024 finally brought back bush trips (top 5 you need to fly)
description:
52 missing adventures, hundreds of flight legs, and the return of a fan-favorite mode: Sim Update 6 officially brings back every legacy bush trip into Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 for free.

With fully upgraded ground detail, native EFB tablet nav-log integration, enhanced atmospheric physics, and new micro-terrain density, these aren't just direct ports—they feel like native 2024 adventures. But with 52 routes available, where should you start?

In this video, we break down the top 5 bush trips to fly first, covering everything from dead reckoning visual navigation along the Adriatic coast to extreme density altitude engine management in the high Sierra Nevadas and Patagonia.

⏱️ Timestamps:
00:00 - Intro
00:31 - Rijeka to Santorini
01:01 - Breckenridge to Mariposa-Yosemite
01:35 - Los Cerros to Cochrane - Patagonia
02:13 - Grand Alpine Challenge
02:47 - Bordeaux to Mont Blanc

✈️ Key Technical Features Highlighted:
• EFB Tablet Integration: Nav logs and mini-map toggle for true dead reckoning navigation
• Atmospheric Updates: Realistic mixture control & density altitude effects above 10,000 ft
• Visual Upgrades: High-resolution mesh, razor-sharp rock shaders, and micro-terrain density

Which bush trip are you loading up first? Drop your favorite route in the comments below!
